story.festival_harvest.name: Harvest festival
story.festival_harvest.desc: A harvest-festival challenge: bring in sixty plants — fruit, grain, flowers, pumpkins.
story.festival_harvest.ch.c1.sum: Harvest sixty plants during the harvest festival — whatever grows on your world counts.
story.festival_harvest.r1.start: A harvest festival is on! People all over the world bring in the harvest together. Harvest sixty plants — berries, grain, fruit, anything that grows — and I have a present for you.
story.festival_harvest.graduated: A harvest to be proud of. Here: lanterns and marigold seeds for your garden.
story.festival_harvest.d1.start: Harvest sixty plants. Every plant that gives you something counts — berries, grain, fruit, mushrooms, pumpkins.
story.festival_harvest.d1.done: Sixty plants! The harvest is in.
